vacancy_tiers._comment: Holding-cost vacancy prior tiered by (beds, price band). Flat 0.75mo (~6%) was format-blind; large/luxury formats let slower (smaller qualified-tenant pool, longer marketing, more fit-out turnover) while small mass-market units re-let fastest. Selection (full_scorer/roi pass beds+price): high tier if beds>=4 OR price>high_price_max; low tier if beds<=2 AND price<=low_price_max; else mid (== flat default). Fallback when beds OR price is absent = vacancy_months_per_year (0.75), so callers without both are unchanged. Basis: SG private non-landed occupancy ~94% small/mass-market (~0.5mo), ~92-93% mid (~0.75mo), high-quantum/large ~88-90% (~1.0-1.2mo); URA/agency void-period norms, deliberately conservative on the luxury tail.
